validation.name: Manual and transactional limitations
validation.detail: No physical-device or human screen-reader test. Read-only live browser checks block mutation requests; no purchases, payments, database mutations or customer messaging tested. Performance preserved by identical source and UI smoke checks; no new performance benchmark. Local Change History appended; certified deployment source intentionally unchanged, so these new reports require a later learning-app release to reach other devices.
